title: zazzled component diagram
description: The zazzled crate and what crosses its boundary: the C invoker and MCP clients call it; it drives launchd on macOS, asks zazzle-csharp-indexer for C# views, and as the MCP proxy talks to other MCP servers. The crate's parts are in the src/ diagram.

components.name: zazzled
components.responsibility: The daemon, its MCP front end, the MCP proxy, the command runner, its installer and the zazzle commands, in one binary.

components.name: zazzled source
components.responsibility: Library and binary entry: front ends, wire protocol, engine, caches, commands, proxy and runner.

components.name: zazzle invoker
components.responsibility: The C client a shell runs: passes its command line, streams and working directory to the daemon and exits with its status, or execs `zazzled proxy` and `zazzled wrap`.

components.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer
components.responsibility: The C# tool whose daemon renders the terse view of a C# file.

components.name: MCP client
components.responsibility: The coding agent's client, which starts `zazzled mcp` and calls its tools over standard input and output, or starts `zazzle proxy` in front of another server.

components.name: Upstream MCP server
components.responsibility: Any other MCP server the proxy sits in front of, run as a child over stdio or reached over Streamable HTTP.

components.name: launchd
components.responsibility: macOS's service manager: holds an installed LaunchAgent's socket and starts `zazzled serve` on demand.

relationships.description: Sends requests over the unix socket in descriptor mode, starts `zazzled serve` when nothing listens, and execs `zazzled proxy` and `zazzled wrap`.
Starts `zazzled mcp` and speaks JSON-RPC to it, or talks to another server through `zazzled proxy`.
Starts its daemon when needed and asks its `view` tool over the daemon's socket.
The proxy relays the client's messages to it and cleans its answers.
